sentences.en: Speaking of the script, I have a script catch.
sentences.zh: 说到剧本，我发现了一个剧本上的小细节。

sentences.en: So, you know, in the scene, we set the box on fire.
sentences.zh: 在那个场景里，我们把盒子点着了。

sentences.en: In the shooting draft of the script, we buried the bird.
sentences.zh: 但在拍摄用的剧本初稿里，我们是把鸟埋了。

sentences.en: There was a scene where Michael and Dwight are digging a hole outside, and then we all
sentences.zh: 原本有一场戏是迈克尔和德怀特在外面挖坑，然后我们所有人

sentences.en: gather around this hole.
sentences.zh: 围在坑边。

sentences.en: And it got changed to fire, but I don't know why.
sentences.zh: 后来改成了火葬，但我不知道为什么。

sentences.en: I think maybe, Angela, there was really no grass in this area that we shot.
sentences.zh: 我想可能是因为，安吉拉，我们拍摄的那块地方根本没有草地。

sentences.en: We had no grass.
sentences.zh: 我们没有草地。

sentences.en: There was a hedge with maybe, like, I don't know, three feet of dirt.
sentences.zh: 那里只有一道树篱，大概只有三英尺宽的泥地。

sentences.en: Like, yeah, there was, I mean, not even.
sentences.zh: 对，没错，我是说，甚至连三英尺都没有。

sentences.en: There is a deleted scene where Michael and Dwight are trying to dig a hole there, and
sentences.zh: 有一个删减片段是迈克尔和德怀特试图在那里挖坑，然后

sentences.en: then the business on the other side yells at them, and they run away.
sentences.zh: 另一边的人冲他们大喊大叫，他们就跑开了。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 噢，原来如此。

sentences.en: Well, there you go.
sentences.zh: 好吧，真相大白了。

sentences.en: Well, we had another fan question about this fire, then.
sentences.zh: 那我们还有另一个关于这场火的粉丝提问。

sentences.en: Clara Johnson wants to know, did you actually set the bird on fire?
sentences.zh: 克拉拉·约翰逊想知道，你们是真的把那只鸟点着了吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Real fire, fake bird.
sentences.zh: 火是真的，鸟是假的。

sentences.en: Kent told me they had to hire a special effects guy to oversee the fire and the extinguishing,
sentences.zh: 肯特告诉我，他们必须雇一个特效人员来监督点火和灭火过程，

sentences.en: and they had to get a special permit to be allowed to set the fire.
sentences.zh: 而且他们必须申请特别许可才能获准点火。

sentences.en: And he said we did three takes.
sentences.zh: 他说我们拍了三次。

sentences.en: Three takes of the fire.
sentences.zh: 火烧了三次。

sentences.en: And Phil told me, though, that the special effects guys were worried that the fake dead
sentences.zh: 不过菲尔告诉我，特效人员担心那只假死鸟

sentences.en: bird might give off toxic fumes when it burned.
sentences.zh: 在燃烧时可能会产生有毒烟雾。

sentences.en: So they actually took it out of the box and just put a wad of toilet paper in there.
sentences.zh: 所以他们实际上把它从盒子里拿了出来，只放了一团卫生纸进去。

sentences.en: Oh, not toilet paper.
sentences.zh: 噢，别提卫生纸。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Too soon.
sentences.zh: 太早了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Too soon, Angela.
sentences.zh: 太早了，安吉拉。

sentences.en: Too soon.
sentences.zh: 太早了。

sentences.en: And then finally, we had a fan catch from Peter K.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们收到了彼得·K的一个粉丝发现。

sentences.en: He said, I noticed the box was burned in some shredded paper.
sentences.zh: 他说，我注意到盒子里烧的是一些碎纸。

sentences.en: Could this be further evidence that Pam does use the shredder?
sentences.zh: 这是否进一步证明了帕姆确实用了碎纸机？

sentences.en: Oh, look at that.
sentences.zh: 噢，你看那个。

sentences.en: Nice one, Peter.
sentences.zh: 干得好，彼得。

sentences.en: It would appear so.
sentences.zh: 看来确实如此。

sentences.en: Well, you know, Jen actually left us a really great message about this scene.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，简其实给我们留了一条关于这一幕的很棒的信息。

sentences.en: And she was talking about the fact that we never got to shoot outside.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了我们从未在户外拍摄过的事实。

sentences.en: And when we did, everyone would get really excited.
sentences.zh: 而当我们真的去户外时，每个人都会非常兴奋。

sentences.en: And she explains a little bit about that.
sentences.zh: 她对此做了一些解释。

sentences.en: So, Sam, can you play that?
sentences.zh: 所以，萨姆，你能播放一下吗？

sentences.en: One thing that I remember from the grief counseling episode is that when I went to the sound mix,
sentences.zh: 我记得关于“悲伤辅导”那一集的一件事是，当我参加混音时，

sentences.en: they were showing us the playback of the episode.
sentences.zh: 他们正在给我们播放那一集的录音。

sentences.en: And it was still a little bit unusual when the characters went outside.
sentences.zh: 当角色们走到户外时，感觉还是有点不寻常。

sentences.en: It was still a little bit of a treat.
sentences.zh: 那仍然算是一种小小的享受。

sentences.en: So, we get to this bird funeral scene.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们来到了这场鸟儿葬礼的戏份。

sentences.en: And our characters are outside.
sentences.zh: 我们的角色都在户外。

sentences.en: And I just remember hearing kind of an enormous amount of birds.
sentences.zh: 我只记得听到了一种巨大的鸟叫声。

sentences.en: And I think that it was because we were outside.
sentences.zh: 我想那是因为我们在户外。

sentences.en: It was because we had a bird funeral.
sentences.zh: 那是因为我们举行了一场鸟儿葬礼。

sentences.en: It was so exciting for the amazing sound people, who do a fantastic job, to put a lot of bird noises in.
sentences.zh: 对于那些出色的音效师来说，能加入大量的鸟叫声一定非常令人兴奋，他们做得太棒了。

sentences.en: And because for the longest time, when we're inside the office, they're just putting dot matrix printer sounds and just faxes and old-fashioned office noises.
sentences.zh: 因为在很长一段时间里，当我们待在办公室里时，他们只能加入针式打印机的声音、传真声和老式的办公室噪音。

sentences.en: So, it must have been such a treat and a field day to be able to go outside and hear birds, and especially on theme with the funeral.
sentences.zh: 所以，能够去户外听到鸟叫声，尤其是与葬礼主题相符，对他们来说一定是一种享受和狂欢。

sentences.en: So, I remember, it was a slight exaggeration, but it sounded a little bit like Alfred Hitchcock, the birds, when I first heard the playback for the bird funeral.
sentences.zh: 我记得，虽然有点夸张，但当我第一次听到鸟儿葬礼的录音时，听起来有点像阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克的《群鸟》。

sentences.en: But they quickly made a wonderful adjustment, and it was the right amount of outside birds.
sentences.zh: 但他们很快做出了极好的调整，那才是户外鸟叫声的正确音量。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这一点。

sentences.en: I love that our sound mixers got so excited.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我们的混音师们如此兴奋。

sentences.en: They put, like, hundreds of birds, and they were like, okay, guys, there's not this many birds outside.
sentences.zh: 他们放了大概几百只鸟的声音，然后他们意识到，好吧，伙计们，外面没有这么多鸟。

sentences.en: Let's dial it back.
sentences.zh: 我们调小一点吧。

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: Oh, what good insight from Jen this week.
sentences.zh: 噢，简这周的见解真好。

sentences.en: Yes, thank you so much, Jen Salata, for sending in those clips and for texting me.
sentences.zh: 是的，非常感谢简·萨拉塔发来这些片段并给我发短信。

sentences.en: You are amazing.
sentences.zh: 你太棒了。

sentences.en: We so appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感激。

sentences.en: And thank you, Rashida, for letting me bug you about all kinds of random things yesterday.

sentences.zh: 我们爱你，敏迪。

sentences.zh: 这就是“悲伤辅导”那一集。
